native_budget.excluded_costs: Shared original preparation, ingress screening, selected initial inventory and independent audit must be reported separately.

native_preview_profile.scope: process cumulative native preview calls, including constructor/fresh/next-inventory work
native_preview_profile.unmeasured: internal preview subphases, bytes copied/hashed, engine initialization and integrity time require separate profiling

native_budget.request_interpretation: Zero-preview returns may be cached, empty or STOP-only; cache hits are not instrumented.
native_budget.wall_limit: Cooperative checks; in-flight native/C work cannot be forcibly stopped here. External process supervision is required.

resource_authority: owned parent hard wall, sampled tree RSS and final output receipt
scope: offline training/readout and deployment separate; nested inclusive scopes must not be summed
